title: Master's Thesis (M.Psi.)
description: Investigated the moderating role of student engagement in environmental organizations on the link between climate change skepticism and pro-environmental behavior. Methods: Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) & Linear Regression. Tools: Jamovi, R Studio.

title: Competency-Based HRM System Design
description: Audited and redesigned a comprehensive competency-based HRM system for Barista positions to align specialty quality strategies with retail efficiency. Methods: Job Analysis, BEI STAR, BARS, KPI, and ADDIE Model for training curriculums.

title: The Boundary Conditions of Climate Change Skepticism
description: This manuscript in preparation explores the boundary conditions of climate change skepticism, specifically examining how student engagement can moderate the link to environmental activism behavior.

title: Adaptation and Validation of the Environmental Cynicism Scale
description: Published in Jurnal Ecopsy, this collaborative research details the process of adapting and validating the Indonesian version of the Environmental Cynicism Scale, ensuring its psychometric reliability and validity for local contexts.

title: Saat Sinisme Menjadi Satu-satunya Respon yang Masuk Akal di Tengah Kerusakan Alam
description: Sebuah esai opini mengenai tingkah laku sistem yang menggerus kepercayaan publik dan melahirkan sinisme lingkungan di masyarakat Indonesia.

title: Pro-environmental Behavior among Coffee Farmers
description: Co-authored and published in Jurnal Ecopsy, this study investigates the psychological drivers and pro-environmental behaviors specifically within the demographic of coffee farmers in the Muria Mountains area.
